title: Plumbing & Pipefitting
tagline: The dedicated piping-trades path — apprentice to journeyman to master to contractor.
summary: A deep-dive specialization of the Skilled Trades roadmap: plumbing and pipefitting from apprenticeship hours through the journeyman license, service work, master status, and specialty systems.

sources.label: BLS OOH — Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters

detail.description: The piping trades split into plumbers (water, waste, gas in buildings) and pipefitters/steamfitters (industrial process, high-pressure, HVAC piping) — licensed, apprenticeship-trained crafts.
detail.why: Everything leaks eventually — the trade is recession-resistant, ownership-friendly, and impossible to outsource.
learn: Compare plumber vs pipefitter vs steamfitter scopes
Visit a supply house and a job site
Talk to one service plumber and one fitter

resources.title: BLS OOH — Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters

tasks: Assemble, install, and repair pipes, fittings, and fixtures of heating, water, and drainage systems according to specifications and plumbing codes.

detail.description: Plumbing apprenticeships run ~4–5 years of paid OJT hours plus classroom — union JATC or open-shop — covering code, theory, and hands-on systems.
detail.why: Earn-while-you-learn with a license at the end — apply to several programs and prepare for aptitude testing.
learn: Apply to union and open-shop programs
Keep hours documented and signed from day one
Balance experience categories per your license

detail.description: The systems knowledge: DWV (drain-waste-vent) design, water supply, gas piping, and fixture rough-in — learned across residential and commercial projects.
detail.why: Systems understanding is what turns pipe-handling into licensed plumbing — it's the exam and the job.
learn: Learn DWV design: slope, venting, traps
Rough-in a full bathroom on paper correctly

resources.title: BLS OOH — Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters

detail.description: The material craft: copper soldering, threading, PEX expansion, PVC/ABS solvent welds, cast iron, and press fittings — each with code and application logic.
detail.why: Material mastery is daily work and the visible mark of a real tradesperson.
learn: Practice soldering until joints pass inspection
Learn PEX expansion and press systems
Understand where each material is legal
Build clean, measured pipe work habitually

resources.title: BLS OOH — Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters

detail.description: The journeyman license: completed apprenticeship hours plus a state exam covering code, theory, and practical knowledge — licensing unsupervised work.
detail.why: The journeyman card is the trade's degree — full pay rates and the master-track prerequisite.
learn: Verify your state's hour and exam requirements
Take a code-prep course before the exam

certs.name: Journeyman Plumber License
certs.note: Issued after documented apprenticeship hours and passing the state journeyman examination.

detail.description: Service plumbing diagnoses live problems: clogs, leaks, water-heater failures, sewer backups — a diagnostic craft with customer trust at its center.
detail.why: Service work pays the best hourly rates and is the base of most independent plumbing businesses.
learn: Explain options and prices clearly to homeowners

resources.title: BLS OOH — Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters

detail.description: Specialty certifications: backflow prevention assembly testing, medical gas, steam systems, and septic/well work — each adds legal capabilities and pay.
detail.why: Certifications expand what you can legally do — the tested path to premium wages.

detail.description: Pipefitting and steamfitting serve plants and process systems: high-pressure pipe, welding, blueprints, and rigging — bigger systems, bigger tolerances, industrial pay.
detail.why: Industrial pipefitting is the trade's heavy segment — strong union wages and long projects.
learn: Train in rigging and high-pressure safety
Note welding certifications that pair with fitting

resources.title: BLS OOH — Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters

detail.description: The master license adds years and a design-level exam — qualifying you to plan systems, pull permits, supervise, and (with a contractor license) own the business.
detail.why: Master status unlocks contracting, estimating authority, and inspection careers.
learn: Study design-level calculations and code depth

certs.name: Master Plumber License
certs.note: Senior license after additional experience and a design-focused examination; often required to contract.

detail.description: Contractor ownership: business license, bonding and insurance, estimating, crews, and the service-truck economics that make plumbing businesses durable.
detail.why: Ownership is the wealth path — master-level credibility plus business systems.
learn: Learn job costing and truck-stock economics

detail.description: Master-level plumbers move into inspection for cities and counties: plan review and field inspection against code — steady hours using deep code knowledge.
detail.why: Inspection is the classic second act — respected, stable, and code-centered.
learn: Shadow an inspector for a day

detail.description: Ladder: helper → apprentice → journeyman → master/foreman → contractor-owner or inspector — each rung licensed and clearly defined.
detail.why: The piping trades ladder is visible and license-gated: you can always see the next step's requirements.
learn: Map your state's ladder and timelines
Choose service vs construction vs industrial focus
Find a mentor one rung ahead

resources.title: BLS OOH — Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters

detail.description: Crawls, trenches, and heavy fixtures wear bodies: knee/back protection, lifting technique, and honest transitions toward inspection, supervision, or ownership.
detail.why: Longevity planning at year five prevents the injury-driven exits that end good careers.
learn: Use knee and back protection without exception
Keep a strength and mobility routine

detail.description: Service plumbing sells trust: clear explanations, options with honest prices, clean workspaces, and showing up when promised — reviews follow.
detail.why: Trust is the entire service business — plumbers known for honesty never run out of work.
learn: Present three options with prices every time
